# 3M tech

> 3M tech is a digital product and web development studio in Egypt. We design and build intentional, scalable digital products for startups and established businesses across Egypt and the Middle East.

## Core services
- Custom web application development
- E-commerce platform development
- Shopify store setup and customization
- MVP design and development
- UI/UX research, wireframes, prototypes, and design systems
- Maintenance, technical support, and software optimization
- Custom digital platforms, management systems, and business automation
- Educational platforms, e-learning products, and custom LMS development

## Editorial note
3M tech does not produce random AI-generated design directions. Product decisions are based on research, business goals, product thinking, and human creative judgment.
